server_side_pipeline_ms.note: Parsed from the runtime's structured logs (span: infer, infer_latency_ns), excluding HTTP transport and JSON encoding. Client round trips above are dominated by sending the encoded image as a JSON number array; the binary tensor extension would close that gap.

caveats: Inference is TensorRT FP16 on GPU in all three configurations and identical between them.
GPU postprocessing uses a custom CUDA DALI operator plugin; the plugin and the serialized pipeline are tied to one DALI version (1.51.2 here).
DALI outputs are copied device->host by the backend and re-uploaded by the next step. Writing straight into the downstream device buffer would remove two full-tensor copies per frame.
